name: app-violet-gradient-ecommerce-cards-cart-and-product-detail
title: Violet Shopping Cards, Cart and Product Detail
whatItIs: A violet gradient board of rounded panels: two product cards with heart and price buttons, a cart list with quantity dropdowns and delete buttons, and a phone showing a sneaker detail with colour and size chips and a price button, with chrome ribbons behind.
whatItMeans: Pale product photos on white cards pop against the violet gradient, and one purple accent unifies actions.
techniques: Outlined price buttons on product cards
Violet selected states for size and heart
Chrome ribbon loops behind the phone
Top-item yellow sticker as a highlight
Grey image tiles for product cutouts

vocabulary.definition: A button that shows the price and adds to cart.
A yellow tag marking a featured product.
A compact selector to change item count.
